summary: Today’s market tone is mixed-to-risk-off in macro assets, while crypto commentary skews selectively bullish on a handful of altcoins and cautious on Bitcoin near resistance. Reuters’ latest market snapshot shows weaker gold and Brent alongside softer equities, while recent analyst coverage highlights rotation into altcoins such as AVAX, AAVE, ARB, UNI, ETHFI, NEAR, ZEC, SOL, SUI, and TAO.
